        app.kubernetes.io/instance: healthcare-api

              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 10
            periodSeconds: 10
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /ready
              port: http
            initialDelaySeconds: 5
            periodSeconds: 5
            timeoutSeconds: 3
            failureThreshold: 3

            limits:
              cpu: 500m
              memory: 1Gi
            requests:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 512Mi

            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            runAsNonRoot: true
            runAsUser: 10001

                - ALL

              type: RuntimeDefault
